escena.titulo: The Great Acceleration and the Anthropocene

visual.pie: The Anthropocene: human impact at planetary scale

turnos.t: A proposed new epoch. Evidence: carbon dioxide above 420 parts per million, the highest in 800,000 years; species loss 100 to 1,000 times the background rate; and microplastics from Arctic ice to human blood. The working group proposed 1950 as the start, marked by radionuclides from nuclear tests. But careful: in March 2024 the proposal was voted down, so the Anthropocene is not an official geological epoch.
